messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: leave-one-out cross-validation in lavaan
parts:
Am wondering if jack-knife type methods (leave-one-out) are automated for lavaan. Does anyone know?
I look at the bootstrapLavaan function, but didn't see any options there for such a maneuver.

I don't think it is automated, but it would be easy to execute.

thing.to.save <- rep(NA, nrow(my.data))
for (i in 1:nrow(my.data)) {
    out <- lavaan(my.model, my.data[ , -i], ...)
    thing.to.save[i] <- inspect(out, "whatever")[my.index]
}

Terry
